propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under pytest -n 3 --dist worksteal but passes in isolation because the reconciler entrypoint leaks WARNING level to the shared rebar_reconciler root logger process-globally
the existing _rebar_log_propagation_guard in conftest.py is hardcoded to restore level for only the rebar root logger, missing the sibling rebar_reconciler root that the reconciler subprocess uses

caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger argument raises only the ROOT logger level, so INFO records from rebar_reconciler are dropped by isEnabledFor at the originating logger before handlers see them, while WARNING records still propagate

the test's per-item decline line emitted as logger.warning() is captured, but the pass-summary line emitted as logger.info() is dropped, proving the store was not None and the mechanism is level leakage not storeless-path selection
generalizing the log containment guard to cover both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots makes log assertions order-independent across xdist workers
